# `modernize-removed-syntax`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: style · Profile: modernize · Default: off · Fixes: fix all · Options: none

Reports removed syntax: `@cImport`, obvious array multiplication expressions
using `**`, `void{}`, `errdefer` error captures and the `i0` primitive type (Zig
0.17), `usingnamespace` (0.15), and the `async`, `await`, `suspend` and `resume`
keywords of async functions.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

These constructs no longer compile. Migration requires the official translate-c
package, typed `@splat` initialization for single-element repetition (or an
initializer or loop for larger patterns), `{}`, caller-side `catch` handling, or
review of whether `u0` expresses the intended zero-bit type. Code that mixed a
namespace in with `usingnamespace` re-exports the declarations it needs, and
async functions become `std.Io` tasks: `io.async(function, .{ args })` returns a
`std.Io.Future` whose `await(io)` gives the result.

## When it fires

Token scanning can provide migration guidance even when the current compiler
cannot parse the source. Only removing `void` from `void{}` carries a fix. Array
multiplication requires an obvious literal or a scoped binding with a known
array or vector type, so pointer-to-pointer syntax is skipped. Unknown operand
types receive no finding. Scoped declarations named `i0` are skipped.

`usingnamespace`, `async` and `await` are ordinary identifiers now, so they are
reported only where the old syntax put them: `usingnamespace` opening a
container declaration, and `async` or `await` directly before an operand
(`async f()`, `await frame`). Members such as `io.async(...)` and
`future.await(io)`, and bindings with those names, are not reported. `suspend`
and `resume` are still keywords, but the compiler rejects them. `nosuspend`
still compiles and is not reported.

See [Zig 0.17 language
changes](https://ziglang.org/download/0.17.0/release-notes.html#Language-Changes).

<!-- rule-docs:footer (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
## Example

```zig
const unit = void{};
```
